get.heroSubtitle: Local-first, high-performance batch media processing with a visual node engine. Professional automation for creative workflows.
get.videoUnsupported: Your browser does not support the video tag.
get.cap1Desc: Extract and parse metadata effortlessly from thousands of files.
get.cap1Detail: ZumiLabs Studio reads EXIF data, GPS coordinates, and embedded dates at lightning speed. Use this data to power your workflows automatically.
get.cap2Desc: Utilise built-in local AI models to understand your content.
get.cap2Detail: Scan images for faces, automatically remove backgrounds, or detect blurry photos without sending your files to the cloud. Total privacy, total power.
get.cap3Desc: Apply high-end filters, color grading, and structural transformations.
get.cap3Detail: Apply cinematic color grading, adjust contrast, and execute pixel-perfect crops across thousands of images in seconds.
get.cap4Desc: Add dynamic captions, watermarks, and titles mapped to data.
get.cap4Detail: Turn metadata into beautiful overlays. Drop the location name and date onto every single photo from your travel folder automatically.
get.cap5Desc: Combine multiple inputs into powerful single outputs.
get.cap5Detail: Stitch hundreds of photos into a seamless timelapse video, a dynamic PowerPoint presentation, or an animated GIF with minimal effort.
get.cap6Desc: Generate production-ready deliverables from the ground up.
get.cap6Detail: Produce finished portfolios, contact sheets, and marketing materials directly from the app, tailored exactly to your brand.
get.cap7Desc: Route files dynamically into intelligent folder structures.
get.cap7Detail: Tired of manually sorting files? Let ZumiLabs Studio move your landscape photos into one folder, and portraits into another, automatically.
get.userIndividualsDesc: Auto-categorize messy photo dumps, compile vacation memories into simple timelapses, and efficiently format images for sharing or archiving without needing complex editing software.
get.userPhotographersDesc: Batch process exports, apply uniform watermarks, auto-generate client contact sheets, extract EXIF data for cataloging, and standardise color profiles across large shoots.
get.userCreatorsDesc: Adapt singular media into various formats for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. Automatically overlay branding, slice highlights, and convert snippets into engaging GIFs.
get.userEnterpriseDesc: Build robust product photography pipelines, clear backgrounds via local AI, standardise margins for thousands of SKUs, and strip sensitive metadata for compliance.
get.automationDesc1: Think of ZumiLabs Studio as your tireless creative assistant. You can set simple rules—like "skip blurry photos" or "only process landscapes"—and let it do the heavy lifting on thousands of images at once.
get.automationDesc2: Just Ask Claude: Describe what you want in plain English, and our AI will instantly build the perfect editing workflow for you. No technical skills required.

sys.title: Global Settings
sys.languageDesc: Choose the display language for the interface.
sys.notLinked: Not linked. Thumbnails will use base64 fallback.
sys.projectStorageDesc: Linking the project root allows the app to save recipe thumbnails directly into the samples/ and user-samples/ folders for persistence.

sys.htmlInCanvasDesc: Check this if you have enabled the HTML-in-Canvas flag in Chrome (chrome://flags/#canvas-draw-element). Bypasses the auto-detection check and removes the "Setup required" warning from Hyperframe recipes.
sys.smartThumbsLabel: Crop recipe & showcase covers around the subject
sys.smartThumbsDesc: Uses InSPyReNet saliency to detect the subject of each uploaded image and centre the thumbnail on it, instead of cropping to the image centre. Requires the AI model to be downloaded (see #mdl). Falls back to centre-crop silently when unavailable.
sys.rebuildThumbsDesc: One-off pass that re-crops all existing recipe and showcase thumbnails using the smart crop.
sys.modelNotReady: InSPyReNet model not downloaded — open #mdl to fetch it, then retry.
sys.batchSyncLabel: Default Output Folder to Input Source
sys.batchSyncDesc: If enabled, you do not need to select an output destination. The system will automatically build outputs natively inside your input directory.
sys.colorSwatchesDesc: Manage standard colors available in the parameter configurator panels.
sys.noSwatches: No swatches configured. Click Add Swatch to create one.
sys.aiEndpointDesc: When set, a Describe Image with AI button appears in the metadata panel. The endpoint receives a multipart/form-data POST with an image file field and a filename text field. It must return JSON matching the ZumiLabs Studio sidecar schema (full sidecar or a raw analysis object). The response is merged into the image sidecar without overwriting your annotations.
sys.localTtsDesc: URL of your self-hosted Local TTS Gateway server. Used by the Voice Studio screen to dynamically query available voices (e.g. VibeVoice, Coqui XTTS) and generate audio.
sys.elevenLabsPlaceholder: Paste your Eleven Labs API key
sys.elevenLabsDesc: Get your API key from Eleven Labs Profile settings. Allows zero-shot high-quality voice synthesis in Voice Studio.
sys.pexelsDesc: Get a free key at pexels.com/api. Supports photos and videos. Free tier: 200 requests/hour.
sys.unsplashDesc: Register an app at unsplash.com/developers. Unsplash issues three credentials — only the Access Key is needed here. Photos only. Demo apps: 50 requests/hour.
sys.pixabayDesc: Get a free key at pixabay.com/api/docs. Supports photos and videos. Free tier: 100 requests/minute.
sys.stockKeysNote: All keys are stored locally in your browser only. Used by the Get Media screen.
sys.masterFontsDesc: Manage fonts available for text styles and overlays.

automationPrompts: deblur photos older than 2020 and re-save as webp
build a contact sheet per folder with watermark
extract faces, group, and rename by person
pow.smartAutomationLede: Describe what you want in plain English. Claude builds the recipe — every node, every parameter — and you just hit Run. No technical skills required.
pow.superchargeLede: These Claude.ai Project skills let you use AI to build recipes and analyse images without writing a single line of code. Set them up once in a Claude Project — then just chat.
pow.recipeArchitectDesc: Describe an image editing workflow in plain English — Claude generates a complete, ready-to-import ZumiLabs Studio recipe JSON with every node and parameter already configured.
pow.architectStep1: Go to claude.ai and create a new Project
pow.architectStep2: Open Project Instructions and paste the contents of claude-recipe-prompt.md
pow.architectStep4: Chat: "Make a recipe that crops to square, adds a soft glow, and watermarks the bottom-right"
pow.architectStep5: Copy the JSON → Library → Import JSON → done!
pow.imageDescriberDesc: Upload any image — Claude produces rich AI analysis JSON (scene, subjects, colour palette, composition, generative prompts, DAM notes) in the exact format ZumiLabs Studio's metadata sidecar expects. Works standalone or wired to the AI endpoint in Settings.
pow.describerStep4: Upload an image and say: "Describe this image for ZumiLabs Studio"
pow.describerStep5: Copy the JSON → paste into any .jpg.json sidecar file, or host a simple endpoint and use Describe with AI in the metadata panel
pow.describerTip: Connect it to the AI endpoint setting for one-click analysis directly inside the metadata panel — no copy-paste required.
